rows.ja: 提携・投資・資金調達

companies.name: タワーセミコンダクター

relations.text: Towerの年次報告が、標準セル、I/O、メモリのIPをSynopsysなどからライセンスしていると記している
relations.text_en: Tower's annual report says it licenses standard cell, I/O and memory IP from Synopsys and other suppliers

source.label: Tower Semiconductor 20-F
source.quote: - and license standard cells, I/O, and memory IP from Synopsys, eMemory, and other top suppliers of physical IP.

relations.text: Towerは、Synopsysなどの設計自動化大手と協業していると記している
relations.text_en: Tower says it collaborates with leading design automation providers including Synopsys

source.label: Tower Semiconductor 20-F
source.quote: we collaborate with leading design automation providers - including Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, Siemens EDA, and Keysight Technologies

relations.text: Synopsys Cloudは、Microsoft Azureとの提携で開発した業界初のEDA SaaSを含む
relations.text_en: Synopsys Cloud includes the industry's first EDA Software-as-a-Service solution developed in partnership with Microsoft Azure

source.label: Synopsys 10-K
source.quote: Our Synopsys Cloud offering provides customers additional options for accessing our EDA products in their own cloud environments and in the industry’s first EDA Software-as-a-Service solution developed in partnership with Microsoft Azure.

relations.text: 2025年12月、NVIDIAへの第三者割当で普通株約480万株を1株414.79ドルで発行し、純額20億ドルを調達した
relations.text_en: In December 2025, Synopsys sold about 4.8 million common shares to NVIDIA at $414.79 per share in a private placement for net proceeds of $2.0 billion

source.label: Synopsys 10-K
source.quote: In December 2025, we entered into a securities purchase agreement for a private placement with NVIDIA Corporation, pursuant to which we sold an aggregate of approximately 4.8 million shares of our common stock at a price of $ 414.79 per share for net proceeds of $ 2.0 billion.

companies.name: グローバルファウンドリーズ

relations.text: CEVAの年次報告が、GlobalFoundriesがSynopsysのIP事業の一部を取得したと記している
relations.text_en: CEVA's annual report says GlobalFoundries acquired certain Synopsys IP businesses

source.label: CEVA 10-K
source.quote: DSP, NPU, and processor IP vendors, including Arm, Cadence, Imagination Technologies, VeriSilicon, Andes Technology, SiFive, Expedera, Quadric and Digital Media Professionals (DMP), as well as GlobalFoundries, which acquired certain Synopsys IP businesses and now participates more directly in the semiconductor IP ecosystem.
source.note: 他社の年次報告による記載です。
source.note_en: Stated in another company's annual report.

relations.text: GlobalFoundriesが2026年1月13日にSynopsys, Inc.との最終契約を締結した
relations.text_en: On January 13, 2026, GlobalFoundries entered into a definitive agreement with Synopsys, Inc.

source.label: GlobalFoundries 20-F
source.quote: Definitive Agreement - On January 13, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive agreement with Synopsys, Inc.

companies.name: キーサイト・テクノロジー

relations.text: Keysightは2025年に、SynopsysのOptical Solutions Group(OSG)の取得に5.78億ドルを使った
relations.text_en: In 2025, Keysight used $578 million for the acquisition of Synopsys' OSG

source.label: Keysight Technologies 10-K
source.quote: In 2025, we used $2,022 million, net of cash acquired, for acquisitions, which included $1,415 million, net of $127 million cash acquired, for the acquisition of Spirent, $578 million used for the acquisition of Synopsys’ OSG, $26 million used for acquisition of Ansys’ PowerArtist RTL Business and $3 million used for other acquisition activity.

relations.text: Keysightは2025年10月17日に、SynopsysからOptical Solutions Groupの事業を取得した
relations.text_en: On October 17, 2025, Keysight acquired the Optical Solutions Group business from Synopsys, Inc.

source.label: Keysight Technologies 10-K
source.quote: On October 17, 2025, we acquired the Optical Solutions Group business (“OSG”) from Synopsys, Inc.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bankと、Synopsys株10億ドル分を買い戻す自己株式取得(ASR)契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Synopsys entered into an accelerated share repurchase agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank to repurchase an aggregate of $1 billion of its stock

source.label: Synopsys 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: accelerated share repurchase agreement (ASR) with JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association to repurchase an aggregate of $1 billion of Synopsys stock.
source.note: 株式買戻しと融資の関係です。

relations.text: 2024年2月13日付の第6次修正契約で、JPMorgan Chase Bankが貸付人の管理代理人を務める
relations.text_en: Under a Sixth Amendment Agreement dated February 13, 2024, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is administrative agent for the lenders

source.label: Synopsys 10-K
source.quote: 10.1 Sixth Amendment Agreement, dated February 13, 2024, by and among Synopsys, as borrower, the lenders party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent for the lenders.

companies.name: ケイデンス・デザイン・システムズ

relations.text: ケイデンス・デザイン・システムズの年次報告が、シノプシスを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Synopsys as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Cadence Design Systems 10-K
source.quote: Key competitors include Synopsys, Inc., Ansys, Inc.

companies.name: ラムバス
companies.sub: メモリ・インターフェースIP

relations.text: ラムバスの年次報告が、シノプシスを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Synopsys as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Rambus 10-K
source.quote: In the Silicon IP market, Rambus competes with the in-house design teams at our potential customers, as well as with third-party IP suppliers, such as Cadence and Synopsys.

relations.text: JFrogの年次報告が、シノプシスを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Synopsys as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: JFrog 10-K
source.quote: Some security-focused companies may compete with a subset of JFrog’s holistic security offerings or address only developer-level security, such as Aqua Security, Snyk, Checkmarx, Sonatype, and Synopsys.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
